ev.q: exploring the open world hub of Lego City
The game is set in Lego City, which serves as an overworld that contains levels
which can involve solving puzzles, building and breaking Lego bricks, and platforming challenges
In the overworld, puzzles and collectibles are also hidden
The player is allowed to use any vehicle in the environment
Lego studs serve as the game's currency
Chase is joined by dim-witted rookie Frank Honey
praised the story, humour, and evolved gameplay formula
follows police officer Chase McCain as he returns to Lego City
